## Which stack or framework?

Name and version (e.g., "Svelte 5", "Go / Fiber", "Ruby on Rails 7").

## What should be included?

Check everything you'd like to see for this stack:

- [ ] Architecture playbook
- [ ] State management guide
- [ ] API layer guide
- [ ] Testing guide
- [ ] Performance guide
- [ ] Project scaffold
- [ ] AI prompt (Cursor / Copilot / Claude)
- [ ] ESLint / linting rules

## Why is this stack a good fit for ArchitectOS?

Explain the use case, adoption level, and why it warrants enterprise-grade standards.

## Can you contribute?

- [ ] Yes, I can write a draft playbook
- [ ] Yes, I can write a draft scaffold
- [ ] I can review a draft
- [ ] I cannot contribute but believe this is important
